scope: what each part of the twin that never ran needs before it can run: the tool and its witness, the inputs held and missing, what a contribution would have to hold, and the first steps once the inputs exist. A preparation: nothing here is a result

tool.witness_state: passed on 2026-11-22 at the second declared attempt (twins/935-cylinder-head-cad-twin/params/dynamics-witness.json): a natural frequency and the two modes of a two-mass chain within 3e-7, the contact force of a preloaded follower on a simple-harmonic lift law within 5e-6 of its peak, the float speed within 5e-5, three planted faults caught. The first attempt, a turning cam, failed: the follower floats wherever the cam surface accelerates away from it (twins/935-cylinder-head-cad-twin/params/dynamics-witness-rotating-cam.json)
